scenes.label: Meet Tara
scenes.title: Twelve storybooks for sale
scenes.caption: Meet Tara. She and Mum are selling her old storybooks online, twelve books for ₹500. The money will go toward a telescope! Within minutes a buyer messages: I'll take them all, and I'll pay right now by QR code. Tara can't believe her luck.
scenes.speech: Meet Tara. She and Mum are selling her old storybooks online, twelve books for five hundred rupees. The money will go toward a telescope! Within minutes a buyer messages: I'll take them all, and I'll pay right now by Q R code. Tara can't believe her luck.

scenes.label: Scan to receive?
scenes.title: “Receive”? The screen says Pay.
scenes.caption: The buyer sends a QR code: scan this to receive ₹500. Tara scans it on Mum's phone. But the screen says Pay ₹500, and it asks for the UPI PIN. The buyer keeps typing: hurry, it's only verification! Tara's finger stops just above the keypad.
scenes.speech: The buyer sends a Q R code: scan this to receive five hundred rupees. Tara scans it on Mum's phone. But the screen says Pay five hundred rupees, and it asks for the U P I pin. The buyer keeps typing: hurry, it's only verification! Tara's finger stops just above the keypad.
scenes.dialogue: Receive? But the screen says Pay!

scenes.label: How UPI works
scenes.title: A PIN is only for paying.
scenes.caption: Tara shows Mum. Mum explains how UPI, the Unified Payments Interface, works. A UPI PIN is only ever used to pay or send money. You never need a PIN, or a scan, to receive money. To get paid, you share your own QR code, and the buyer scans it.
scenes.speech: Tara shows Mum. Mum explains how U P I, the Unified Payments Interface, works. A U P I pin is only ever used to pay or send money. You never need a pin, or a scan, to receive money. To get paid, you share your own Q R code, and the buyer scans it.
scenes.dialogue: So a PIN always means money leaves?

scenes.label: Stop and choose
scenes.title: Read the screen, then decide.
scenes.caption: Your turn. First, read the pretend payment screen and stop the payment without a PIN. Then choose the safe way for Tara to get paid. Remember what Mum said about who scans whose code. Careful: entering the PIN to receive is exactly the trick.
scenes.speech: Your turn. First, read the pretend payment screen and stop the payment without a pin. Then choose the safe way for Tara to get paid. Remember what Mum said about who scans whose code. Careful: entering the pin to receive is exactly the trick.

scenes.label: The UPI rules
scenes.title: Pay means money goes out.
scenes.caption: Tara cancels, and not a single rupee leaves. The rules are simple. Read the screen before you tap: Pay means money goes out. Never enter your PIN to receive. And if a buyer rushes you, stop and ask an adult. If money is lost, call 1930 and report at cybercrime.gov.in.

scenes.label: A happier ending
scenes.title: ₹500, and no PIN at all
scenes.caption: The pushy buyer vanishes, and Mum reports the account to the website. The next day, a real buyer scans Mum's QR code, and ₹500 arrives, with no PIN at all. The telescope fund grows! Your turn: help Tara check payment screens and keep PINs private!

scenes.dialogue: Paid, and our PIN stayed private!
